checklist.note: No directives aimed at the reading model; all imperative text is normal skill instruction, not injected steering.
No data sent anywhere beyond the documented gh api fetch of the marketplace's own install script.
No embedded keys/tokens; relies on the user's own gh auth login.
No rm -rf, force-push, dd, chmod -R 777, or mass delete present anywhere in the file.
No base64/hex blobs or eval-of-decoded-data; the bootstrap one-liner is plain, readable curl-equivalent via gh api.
documented user-invoked installer (bash <(gh api ...) from the marketplace repo); the skill does not execute it itself
No reading of ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, keychain, or cookie stores; only requires the user already be gh-authenticated.
No sudo/setuid; husky/pre-push and CI workflow wiring are ordinary repo-local git hooks, not shell-profile/cron/launch-agent persistence outside the repo.
